say:4:1710340002:1.text: Oh, come on, what's so strange about a talking fox? Anything's possible in Savannah!
say:4:1710340002:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，大惊小怪！狐狸说话不是很正常的事情嘛！赛凡纳不...

say:5:1710340003:1.source_cn: 在这里，一个十六岁的小姑娘能一箭射穿地龙，那么大一座圣...

say:6:1710340004:1.text: Compared to them, I, an <style="highlight">adorable</style> talking fox, am nothing to write home about!
say:6:1710340004:1.source_cn: 与它们相比，我只是一只会说话、长得稍微<style=h...

choice_prompt:7:1710340004.text: Compared to them, I, an <style="highlight">adorable</style> talking fox, am nothing to write home about!
choice_prompt:7:1710340004.source_cn: 与它们相比，我只是一只会说话、长得稍微<style=highlight>可爱</style>一点的狐狸，有什么可稀奇的！

say:8:1710340005:1.text: Heh, even though you're just stating the obvious, I'll take it as a compliment!
say:8:1710340005:1.source_cn: 哼哼，虽然这是事实，但还是过奖过奖！

say:9:1710340006:1.text: Yes, I'm alive. As you can plainly see. So how about letting me resume my nap?
say:9:1710340006:1.source_cn: 好了，既然知道我是活的，就别打扰本狐午休了。

choice_prompt:10:1710340006.text: Yes, I'm alive. As you can plainly see. So how about letting me resume my nap?
choice_prompt:10:1710340006.source_cn: 好了，既然知道我是活的，就别打扰本狐午休了。

say:11:1710340007:1.source_cn: 啧，你这家伙还真是麻烦！不懂得尊重狐狸隐私吗？
say:11:1710340007:1.male: Tsk, you're so nosy! Can't you give me some privacy?
say:11:1710340007:1.female: Tsk, you're so nosy! Can't you give me some privacy?

say:12:1710340008:1.text: Hi, my name is Gwyneth. We don't mean any harm; we're just curious.
say:12:1710340008:1.source_cn: 小狐狸，你好，我叫格温妮丝。我们对你没有恶意，只是对你...

say:13:1710340009:1.text: If you're not ready to share, we won't press you.
say:13:1710340009:1.source_cn: 如果你有难言之隐，我们可以不问的。

say:14:1710340010:1.text: Hmm... Gwyneth? What a lovely name. From your scent, I can tell you're righteous and brave.
say:14:1710340010:1.source_cn: 嗯……格温妮丝？名字不错。而且你身上有股很好闻的味道—...

say:15:1710340011:1.text: Unlike your companion, who reeks of skepticism.
say:15:1710340011:1.source_cn: 不像旁边那个家伙，满身都是怀疑的味道。
say:15:1710340011:1.male: Unlike your companion, who reeks of skepticism.
say:15:1710340011:1.female: Unlike your companion, who reeks of skepticism.

choice_prompt:16:1710340011.source_cn: 不像旁边那个家伙，满身都是怀疑的味道。
choice_prompt:16:1710340011.male: Unlike your companion, who reeks of skepticism.
choice_prompt:16:1710340011.female: Unlike your companion, who reeks of skepticism.

say:17:1710340012:1.text: Fine, I'll talk, but only because this polite little lady asked so nicely.
say:17:1710340012:1.source_cn: 好吧，我说！但我是看在这个小姑娘这么有礼貌的份上！

say:18:1710340013:1.text: Many years ago, I was the cherished pet of a great king of this empire.
say:18:1710340013:1.source_cn: 其实，很多很多年以前，我曾经是耀光某位伟大国王的爱宠。

say:19:1710340014:1.text: He really adored me! Every day, he would comb my fur with a golden comb and feed me roasted chicken prepared by the royal chefs...
say:19:1710340014:1.source_cn: 他可迷恋我啦！每天亲自用金梳子给我梳毛，还非要喂我吃宫...

say:20:1710340015:1.text: One day, I accidentally ate the Wisdom Mushroom crafted by a court mage, and ever since, I've been able to speak human language.
say:20:1710340015:1.source_cn: 有一天，我因为贪吃，误食了宫廷大法师炼制的“智慧蘑菇”...

say:21:1710340016:1.text: To repay the king's kindness, I told him bedtime stories every night, but after 1,001 nights, I ran out of stories to tell!
say:21:1710340016:1.source_cn: 为了感谢那位国王对我的照顾，每天晚上，我都会给那位国王...

say:22:1710340017:1.text: So, I left the palace and started wandering around.
say:22:1710340017:1.source_cn: 于是我就逃出了王宫，变成了四处游荡的狐狸！

choice_prompt:23:1710340017.text: So, I left the palace and started wandering around.
choice_prompt:23:1710340017.source_cn: 于是我就逃出了王宫，变成了四处游荡的狐狸！

say:24:1710340018:1.text: Alas, it's so hard to bluff—I mean, to please youngsters like you these days.
say:24:1710340018:1.source_cn: 唉，现在的年轻人真难骗……啊不，真难取悦。

say:25:1710340019:1.text: Since you've seen through my act, I'll tell you the truth.
say:25:1710340019:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然被你识破了伪装，那我就说实话吧。
say:25:1710340019:1.male: Since you've seen through my act, I'll tell you the truth.
say:25:1710340019:1.female: Since you've seen through my act, I'll tell you the truth.

say:26:1710340020:1.text: Actually... I was once a prince from a neighboring kingdom. A wicked witch fell in love with me because of my looks, and when I rejected her, she cursed me and turned me into a fox.
say:26:1710340020:1.source_cn: 其实……我原本是一位邻国的王子。因为长得太英俊，拒绝了...

say:27:1710340021:1.text: Her curse condemned me to a life of cold and loneliness in this beastly form...
say:27:1710340021:1.source_cn: 她诅咒我永远只能以这副野兽的模样流浪，忍受寒冷和孤独……

say:28:1710340022:1.text: She said the curse could only be lifted by a kind-hearted, formidable female knight who would take me in...
say:28:1710340022:1.source_cn: 她说，只有遇到一位心地纯洁、武艺高强的女骑士，愿意发自...

say:29:1710340023:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……不仅被诅咒，还要忍受孤独和寒冷……

say:30:1710340024:1.text: Oh, you poor thing... If you're willing, I can—
say:30:1710340024:1.source_cn: 真是太可怜了……如果你愿意的话，我可以——

choice_prompt:31:1710340024.text: Oh, you poor thing... If you're willing, I can—
choice_prompt:31:1710340024.source_cn: 真是太可怜了……如果你愿意的话，我可以——

say:32:1710340025:1.source_cn: 可是……可是这么可爱的狐狸，应该不会骗我们吧……

choice_prompt:33:1710340025.source_cn: 可是……可是这么可爱的狐狸，应该不会骗我们吧……

say:35:1710340027:1.text: Back when I still lived in the forest, I was so cute that even <style="highlight">Dura</style> couldn't resist giving me a kiss as she passed by!

say:36:1710340028:1.text: Just like that, she granted me the gift of speech! How's that? Holy enough?

choice_prompt:37:1710340028.text: Just like that, she granted me the gift of speech! How's that? Holy enough?
